answer: Weight is earned by surviving planted canary audits, not headcount. Each fresh identity posts 400 POA bond in escrow for 6 epochs and grades real work where one item in eight carries a known answer. Peers audit every grade; a failed audit will slash the bond, burn the holdback and eject the key. A glacier of clones pays per key yet shares one signal: keys whose accuracy correlates above 0.7 fold into one cluster and are jointly slashed. Fresh keys wait in a juniper probation queue with zero attestation weight, so fifty fakes fund fifty deposits for one vote.
